components.pass: At least two clear scene/subject vectors share a diagonal direction and lead toward a visible continuation in the frame.
components.fail: A random camera tilt or a lone diagonal decorative object without coherent flow.

components.pass: Actor is visibly off-center with more usable space ahead of the movement than behind; action direction agrees with that space.
components.fail: Centered symmetry or movement running directly out of an immediately cropped edge.

components.pass: A readable foreground object, midground actor and receding background form a traversable spatial route.
components.fail: Flat backdrop, collage depth or incoherent vanishing directions.

components.pass: Pose or localized trailing elements show movement direction while face, connected body and action remain readable at original and thumbnail size.
components.fail: The word dynamic alone, static straight pose, full-frame blur, or unreadable protagonist.

confusion_boundaries: Running alone in a centered flat portrait is insufficient.
Global blur does not prove dynamic composition.
A strong diagonal that competes with or erases the actor is insufficient.
fixed_scene_all_of: Adult fictional woman with reference-guided visible face and dark bob with wispy bangs.
